title: Volkswagen blocks Home Assistant by requiring client assertion
summary: Volkswagen has implemented client assertion requirements that effectively block the homeassistant-volkswagencarnet open-source integration from accessing VW vehicle data through their API. This OAuth 2.0 security change prevents third-party home automation tools like Home Assistant from connecting to Volkswagen accounts, forcing users to rely on official VW apps instead of the flexible open-source alternatives.
problem_solved: Volkswagen blocked unauthorized third-party access to their car connectivity services by requiring client assertion validation in their OAuth flow
why_valuable: This issue highlights the ongoing tension between manufacturer lock-in and user freedom in connected car ecosystems, where car owners cannot easily access their own vehicle data through third-party tools they prefer
